nodes.name: describe_definitions
nodes.func: changed: keep the public signature, one existing section walk, requested-name order and deduplication, and all existing describe/refusal behavior; after requested definitions are available, associate their already-final values with unique entry positions in request-local `definitions_by_position` without another describe, then call `_build_occupancy_index(span_entries, is_array_entry, definitions_by_position, entry_cache)` exactly once for the request; for each unique addressed result pass its `position_by_object[(name, section)]` and the same index to `_shared_with`; address-less results stay untouched, the input stays read-only, and lazy `materialize`/`entry_cache` reuse is unchanged.
examples: (R-A2L-DEF.156/1) one requested name `A` in a three-object inline A2L → result keys `A`, central-index constructions `1`, per-name reconstructions `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.156/2) `A` and `B` at 0x10 and disjoint `C` at 0x80, requested as `A`, `B`, `C` → result keys `A`, `B`, `C`, `A.shared_with` `B`, `B.shared_with` `A`, `C.shared_with` `None`, constructions `1`
(R-A2L-DEF.156/3) names `A`, `A`, `B` at disjoint 0x10 and 0x20 → result keys `A`, `B` in that order, constructions `1`, additional construction for the repeat `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.158/1) for i from `0` through `999`, name `D` + str((i * 7919) % 10007) + `_` + str(i), address `0x1000 + i * 0x40 + (i % 7) * 4`, run with length `1` scalars and valid 4-byte VAL_BLKs → each parametrization has `1000` results, every `shared_with` `None`, at most `20000` checks, total constructions `1`; known-final VAL_BLK open ends `0`, builder describes/materializations `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.158/2) the same arithmetic fixture and two variants for i from `0` through `3999` → each has `4000` results, every `shared_with` `None`, at most `100000` checks, total constructions `1`; known-final VAL_BLK open ends `0`, builder describes/materializations `0`
(R-A2L-DEF.161/1) one requested disjoint `V` among `4000` pairwise-disjoint scalar objects → one result `V`, additional final-span materializations `0`, per-name definition builds `1`

(R-A2L-DEF.161/2) requested VALUE `V` at 0x40 inside earlier-starting CURVE `CX` at 0x20 whose unresolved final length is `64`, among `4000` objects → `V.shared_with` `CX`, additional materializations `1`, definition builds `2`
(R-A2L-DEF.161/3) request `V`, `V` with `CX` declared first → one result key `V`, `V.shared_with` `CX`, additional materializations of `CX` `1`, builds of `V` `1` and `CX` `1`

(R-A2L-DEF.165/1, AT-ALP-I1-1) public batch describe of every unique case_06 name after one warm-up → each of `3` measured runs returns exactly `220040` keys in request order with `0` oracle differences, median at most `30.0` seconds; planned E4 threshold, not measured here

nodes.name: _build_occupancy_index
nodes.func: new private builder: in one position-order pass emit one `IntervalRecord` per entry; for each unique position read any already-materialized tuple from `entry_cache`, else any already-built definition from `definitions_by_position`, and use that final byte length for an exact bounded interval or known final point; only when neither source resolves the entry and its existing lazy route can change its length may an AXIS_PTS or array-like entry receive `last=None`; other entries use their existing final/provisional-as-final length and points; build the implicit complete tree's min/max summaries without sorting, retain every unique position, and build the unique-or-ambiguous `(name, kind)` to position lookup; never call `materialize`, `describe_name`, `_describe_one`, a page expander or a global per-entry rescan, and never retain either input map.
examples: (R-A2L-DEF.157/1) one entry at position `10`, name `P`, kind `CHARACTERISTIC`, address 0x10, length `1` → exactly `1` interval record with first 0x10 and last 0x10, page-expansion records `0`
(R-A2L-DEF.157/2) one entry `C` at 0x10 with length `64` → exactly `1` interval record with first 0x10 and last 0x4F across four 16-byte pages, page-expansion records `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.157/3, R-A2L-DEF.140/10) over-cap `BIG` at 0x0 with length `1048577` and point `V` at 0x100000 → exactly `1` interval for `BIG`, last 0x100000, page-expansion records `0`, and `BIG` remains reachable for `V`

(R-A2L-DEF.158/1) valid disjoint VAL_BLK `VB` at position `20`, address 0x40 and final length `4` already in `definitions_by_position` → last 0x43, known-final open ends `0`, builder calls to describe/materialize `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.158/2) valid disjoint VAL_BLK `VC` at position `21`, address 0x80 and final length `4` already in `entry_cache` → last 0x83, known-final open ends `0`, builder calls to describe/materialize `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.158/1 negative, R-A2L-DEF.158/2 negative) force `last=None` despite the available final length `4` → known-final open ends exceed `0` and the disjoint VAL_BLK checks exceed `20000` or `100000` respectively; planned RED control, not executed

(R-A2L-DEF.140/9) CURVE `CX` at 0x20 absent from both final-length sources with unresolved final length and VALUE `V` at 0x40 → the `CX` record has first 0x20 and last `None`, build-time calls to `materialize` `0`, so the earlier-starting final span remains reachable

(R-A2L-DEF.140/11) malformed multi-value `M` at 0x10 absent from both sources whose tag length is provisionally `4` but whose final length is `None` → its record has last `None`, not provisional last 0x13; final materialization later reduces it to point 0x10

(R-A2L-DEF.162/1, AT-ALP-I1-1) one fresh index over the pinned case_06 tuple population after one warm-up → the warm-up and each of `3` runs retain exactly `220040` records and `220040` unique positions, median build at most `2.5` seconds; planned E4 threshold

(R-A2L-DEF.164/1, AT-ALP-I1-1) build and retain the same case_06 index → each of `3` runs retains `220040` unique positions, traced peak additional allocation at most `67108864` bytes, page-expansion records `0`; planned E4 threshold

nodes.name: _occupancy_candidates
nodes.func: new private lazy iterator: derive the requested inclusive final span or point from `definition`, traverse the position-ordered tree iteratively in preorder-independent in-order sequence, prune only subtrees proved disjoint by the conservative summaries, skip the entry whose position equals `own_position`, and yield each remaining selected original entry without materializing it, collecting aliases or sorting; after a yielded entry proves non-overlapping, continue with the next position. The E4 private generator wrapper at this seam counts a yield only when `_shared_with` consumes it; the independent source arm rejects gather-without-sort, which that counter alone cannot observe.
examples: (R-A2L-DEF.159/1) `BIG` position `1` spans 0x10 through 0x4F, `LATE` position `2` is at 0x40 and `EARLY` position `3` at 0x20, own position `1` → consumed candidates at most `1`, first candidate `LATE`, complete-alias gathers `0`, whole-alias sorts `0`, iterator materializations `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.159/2) `4000` records share one span in reverse name order, queried position `0`, next position `1` named `NEXT` → consumed candidates at most `1`, first candidate `NEXT`, complete-alias gathers `0`, whole-alias sorts `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.159/3) overlapping `FREE` at position `4` and `BLOCK` at position `5` follow the queried position `3` → consumed candidates at most `2`, in order `FREE`, `BLOCK`, complete-alias gathers `0`, whole-alias sorts `0`; gather-without-sort is a planned source-arm RED
(R-A2L-DEF.160/1) same-name, same-span records at positions `10` and `11`, own position `10` → only position `11` is yielded; name/address/span exclusions of position `11` `0`
(R-A2L-DEF.160/2) `A` position `4` and `B` position `5` have identical address, length and byte order, own position `4` → only `B` position `5` is yielded
(R-A2L-DEF.160/3) same-name `DUP` positions `10` and `11` at disjoint 0x10 and 0x80, own position `10` → no candidate is yielded and no name-based grouping occurs
(R-A2L-DEF.161/2) unresolved `CX` at 0x20 with open upper reachability and requested `V` at 0x40 → `CX` is selected before any final-span materialization, candidates materialized by this iterator `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.140/11) malformed `M` at 0x10 is conservative and queried `V` is at 0x12 → `M` may be yielded as a false positive, then traversal resumes at the next position after final materialization proves the point disjoint

nodes.name: _shared_with
nodes.func: changed: replace both the global `span_index[None]` scan and the legacy page gather/sort with `_occupancy_candidates(index, definition, own_position)`; for each selected entry call the existing position-cached `materialize`, continue when `_entry_overlaps` is false or `_pair_exempt` is true, and otherwise return its name immediately; exhaustion or an address-less definition returns `None`, with self excluded only by position before materialization and no complete alias collection or sort.
examples: (R-A2L-DEF.158/1) the `1000` non-uniform pairwise-disjoint arithmetic definitions as scalars and valid 4-byte VAL_BLKs → each variant's every result `None`, at most `20000` calls to `_entry_overlaps`, additional index constructions `0`, known-final VAL_BLK open ends `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.158/2) the corresponding `4000` definitions in both variants → each variant's every result `None`, at most `100000` calls to `_entry_overlaps`, additional index constructions `0`, known-final VAL_BLK open ends `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.159/1, R-A2L-DEF.138/22) `BIG` 0x10 through 0x4F overlaps lower-position `LATE` at 0x40 before higher-position `EARLY` at 0x20 → other `LATE`, consumed candidates at most `1`, final materializations at most `2`, complete-alias gathers `0`, whole-alias sorts `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.159/2) queried smallest position among `4000` same-span records whose names reverse position order, with `NEXT` immediately following → other `NEXT`, consumed candidates at most `1`, final materializations at most `2`, complete-alias gathers `0`, whole-alias sorts `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.159/3) first overlapping scalar pair `FREE` has clean disjoint masks and following `BLOCK` is unmasked → other `BLOCK`, consumed candidates at most `2`, final materializations at most `3`, complete-alias gathers `0`, whole-alias sorts `0`

(R-A2L-DEF.160/1) same-name, same-span records at positions `10` and `11`, queried own position `10` → position `11` is evaluated as the other record and its name `DUP` is returned; only position `10` is excluded
(R-A2L-DEF.160/2) different-name `A` and `B` with identical address, length and byte order, queried `A` at its own position → other `B`, so the other position is not mistaken for self
(R-A2L-DEF.160/3) same-name `DUP` at disjoint 0x10 and 0x80, queried position `10` → other `None`, with no name-only exclusion or grouping
(R-A2L-DEF.161/2, R-A2L-DEF.140/9) requested `V` at 0x40 and selected unresolved `CX` at 0x20 with final length `64` → other `CX`, additional materializations `1`, builds of `V` `1` and `CX` `1`
(R-A2L-DEF.140/10) over-cap `BIG` at 0x0 with length `1048577` covers `V` at 0x100000 → other `BIG`; no lower-window or decode-cap prune applies
(R-A2L-DEF.140/11) malformed `M` at 0x10 materializes to final point length `None` while `V` is at 0x12 → the conservative candidate fails `_entry_overlaps`, traversal continues, other `None`

(R-A2L-DEF.163/1, AT-ALP-I1-1) after one case_06 index build and warm-up, resolve every position through this selector → each of `3` measured runs resolves `220040` positions with `0` `shared_with` differences from the independent source-text oracle, median at most `18.0` seconds; planned E4 threshold

entities.name: [Data: _OccupancyIndex]
entities.desc: one request-local compact position tree; `records` holds one interval per occupancy entry, summary tuples only navigate those records, and `position_by_object` resolves the requested record's walk position without becoming candidate identity; no page expansion or eager final-span description is retained.
